notes.title: The Age of Rime has been added to the latest remake of Myst!
notes.content:
The fan-favorite Age of Rime has been added as a free update to our latest remake of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]Myst[/url][/i]. This new version of Rime includes all-new narrative beats, new lore, and new sights to behold, ensuring that [i]Myst[/i] (2021) is now the definitive and complete way to experience the story and worlds of [i]Myst[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953346/152c49908c38256af0303ea2b22a63aa76f25999.png[/img]

Following the completion of the main story in [i]Myst[/i], or upon loading a completed game, a new journey awaits you somewhere on Myst Island.

The Age of Rime introduces players to the snowy, mountainous seascape that Atrus and his family would visit in years past, before the events of [i]Myst[/i] and [i]Riven[/i] upended their lives. Sweeping vistas, beautiful ice structures, and fantastical natural phenomena await new visitors. This breathtaking new Age also houses a detailed laboratory space where bold experiments were made, delving into the mysterious nature of Linking Books themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953346/69c5f19317e707b9be3367ba1de7c77e789dd122.png[/img]

You can find [i]Myst [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]here[/url]. [i]Myst[/i] is also a part of multiple bundles that will provide a discount based on the purchase of other games in them:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41988/Myst__Riven_The_Definitive_Collection/]Myst & Riven: The Definitive Collection[/url] - a bundle with the latest remakes of both [i]Myst[/i] (2021) and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1712350/Riven/]Riven[/url][/i] (2024).
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37135/Myst_30th_Anniversary_Collection/]Myst 30th Anniversary Collection[/url] - a bundle of all currently available Myst games released on or before 2023, the 30th anniversary of [i]Myst[/i].
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29645/Myst_Through_the_Ages/]Myst: Through the Ages[/url] - a bundle that contains [i]Myst: Masterpiece Edition[/i], [i]realMyst: Masterpiece Edition[/i], and the latest remake of [i]Myst[/i].
[/list]
Thank you for your support of our games!

notes.title: Cyan Reveals Development of Myst for VR
notes.content:
We are so excited to share this news about a new Myst game with you! 

This has been kept close to our chest for a while now, but now that the cat is officially out of the bag, we can finally talk about it… it’s a brand new version of Myst, built for the first time with VR in mind. Coming soon, Myst will be available to play in both 2D and VR! 

Check out our teaser trailer!

[previewyoutube=mtkJkQ3JztY;full][/previewyoutube]

This Myst has been fully redesigned and created from the ground up using the Unreal Engine, the same engine we used on Obduction. Many of the puzzles have been reimagined and engineered to include optional puzzle randomization and also keep accessibility in mind. 

The pictures speak for themselves, go check them out and wishlist now on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]Steam[/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/afb2d2cc2844993b4050a0e2f56b058dc8101121.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/5fbf0ab3ed12443260601a3129248048eb9237fd.jpg[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/7b451d60f8f5d037c03ad4b3e9db7dea23d7a5ae.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/731a9c5dc60d870f51f4b9f1305b50ad7e5c9ba9.jpg[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/ace1e20b14caa96c8bae3b9269b4139fe982e17e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/5d8d0787ae03019bccbbd0ad13989f490687efcd.jpg[/img][/url]

One more thing, 

Right now you can get any game from the Myst series for 50% off, and 10% off extra as a part of the Myst 25th anniversary collection if you complete the set. It's a great time to get back into Myst. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8699/Myst_25th_Anniversary_Collection/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8699/Myst_25th_Anniversary_Collection/[/url]

Thanks, 

The Cyan Team

notes.title: Small Mac update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just pushed out a small update for Mac to help fix up the black screen issue that would show with maximum graphics settings on high resolution displays. While you shouldn't need to from what we've seen, if you continue to have the issue after the update, please delete the graphics.ini file located in /Documents/My Games/Myst V End of Ages/init/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Myst 25th Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience while we were getting this minor update for Myst V: End of Ages ready for Steam.  Thanks too for your support of our games. 

We have been working to ready all of the games in the Myst series for the 25th Anniversary of Myst, which happens later this month. Most of the games in the series required compatibility updates, but Myst V did not - it runs quite nicely on Windows 10!  We do have a few notes for you though.

As a reminder, if you have something you would like to report regarding Myst V, please contact us directly at support@cyan.com. We would be happy to assist you.

Thank you!
The Cyan Worlds Team

[u]Release notes:[/u]

Added original user manuals for English, French, German, Italian, and French.

[u]Known Issues:[/u]

The tablet can appear on-screen during some cut-scenes

In rare cases, the Bahro will become frozen trying to interact with the tablet. This requires the game to be closed and restarted.

Note regarding Conexant audio devices: If you are a Windows 10 user and are experiencing problems with your audio device, you may need to contact Conexant for updated drivers.

notes.title: Win one of four limited edition copies of Myst 25th Anniversary Collection
notes.content:
Myst, one of the most internationally renowned and often baffling adventure games of all time, is getting itself a 25th Anniversary edition, thanks to a hugely successful Kickstarter campaign earlier this year. They asked for $247,500 and got $2,810,127 from backers, so it seems safe to say that people still really like Myst.

Ahead of the release of the fancy 25th Anniversary Edition of Myst, GOG's not only offering up a bunch of discounts on Myst, Uru and Riven titles but also recently became the only place online where you can pick up copies of Myst 3: Exile and Myst 4: Revelation digitally.

In order to celebrate all these lovely things happening all at once, the folks at GOG and Cyan Worlds have gotten together with Jelly Deals to offer up yet another giveaway for you lovely people.

Read more…
